# A soap bubble the duck fires: a faceted ball 0.44 across, sage with a cream light side.
new
material new Bubble --base-color 0.5490 0.6706 0.6314 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Bubble --subdivisions 2 --radius 0.22 --location 0 0 0
material assign Bubble
select all
shade flat
export bubble.glb
